description: This PHP source file defines the ModuleInstaller class for SuiteCRM, handling module installation, uninstallation, extension management, relationship setup, language pack handling, and file operations within the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: ModuleInstaller
classes.description: A class responsible for managing the installation, uninstallation, extension, relationship, and language operations of modules in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Main method to handle the installation process of a module package, including execution of manifest steps, copying files, bean installation, relationship setup, language pack management, cache clearing, and final rebuilding.

methods.name: install_user_prefs
methods.description: Sets user preferences related to display tabs for a given module.

methods.name: uninstall_user_prefs
methods.description: Removes user preferences related to display tabs for a given module.

methods.name: pre_execute
methods.description: Pre-execution hook to include any pre-install scripts defined in the manifest.

methods.name: post_execute
methods.description: Post-execution hook to include any post-install scripts defined in the manifest.

methods.name: pre_uninstall
methods.description: Pre-uninstall hook to include scripts before module removal.

methods.name: post_uninstall
methods.description: Post-uninstall hook to include scripts after module removal.

methods.name: install_copy
methods.description: Handles copying files listed in the installdefs 'copy' section to their destination paths.

methods.name: uninstall_copy
methods.description: Reverts file copies made during installation, restoring from backups.

methods.name: uninstall_new_files
methods.description: Removes files that were added specifically during module installation.

methods.name: getExtDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for module extensions.

methods.name: installExt
methods.description: Installs extension files into the specified Ext directory for given section and module.

methods.name: uninstallExt
methods.description: Removes extension files from the specified Ext directory.

methods.name: rebuildExt
methods.description: Rebuilds the extension by merging files into a single file.

methods.name: disableExt
methods.description: Disables an extension by moving files to a 'Disabled' path.

methods.name: enableExt
methods.description: Re-enables an extension by moving files back from the 'Disabled' path.

methods.name: uninstall_global_search
methods.description: Removes module entries from global search configuration.

methods.name: enable_global_search
methods.description: Enables module entries in global search configuration.

methods.name: disable_global_search
methods.description: Disables module entries in global search configuration.

methods.name: install_extensions
methods.description: Installs all extensions listed in the extensions property.

methods.name: uninstall_extensions
methods.description: Uninstalls all extensions listed.

methods.name: rebuild_extensions
methods.description: Rebuilds all extensions after changes.

methods.name: disable_extensions
methods.description: Disables all extensions.

methods.name: enable_extensions
methods.description: Enables all extensions.

methods.name: install_dashlets
methods.description: Installs dashlets defined in installdefs.

methods.name: uninstall_dashlets
methods.description: Removes dashlets added during installation.

methods.name: install_images
methods.description: Copies image files to theme directories.

methods.name: install_dcactions
methods.description: Installs dashlet container actions.

methods.name: uninstall_dcactions
methods.description: Removes dashlet container actions.

methods.name: install_connectors
methods.description: Installs connector sources and formatters.

methods.name: uninstall_connectors
methods.description: Removes connector sources and formatters.

methods.name: install_vardef
methods.description: Installs vardef extension files for a module.

methods.name: install_layoutdef
methods.description: Installs layout definition files for a module.

methods.name: install_languages
methods.description: Installs language packs for modules.

methods.name: getInstallLanguagesPath
methods.description: Constructs the file path for language files.

methods.name: uninstall_languages
methods.description: Removes language pack files.

methods.name: disable_languages
methods.description: Disables language packs by moving files to a disabled directory.

methods.name: enable_languages
methods.description: Enables language packs by moving files back.

methods.name: enable_manifest_logichooks
methods.description: Enables logic hooks as specified in the manifest.

methods.name: disable_manifest_logichooks
methods.description: Disables logic hooks.

methods.name: uninstallLabels
methods.description: Removes specific labels from language files.

methods.name: uninstallLabel
methods.description: Removes specified label entries from a language file.

methods.name: saveContentToFile
methods.description: Writes labels back to language files after modifications.

methods.name: uninstallExtLabels
methods.description: Removes extended labels for modules.

methods.name: getLabelsToUninstall
methods.description: Extracts label keys to uninstall from label definitions.

methods.name: copy_path
methods.description: Copies files or directories, optionally restoring from backup.

methods.name: install_custom_fields
methods.description: Installs custom fields into modules.

methods.name: uninstall_custom_fields
methods.description: Removes custom fields from modules.

methods.name: install_relationships
methods.description: Installs relationship metadata and related defs.

methods.name: install_relationship
methods.description: Sets up a specific relationship from a metadata file.

methods.name: install_layoutfields
methods.description: Installs layout fields.

methods.name: uninstall_layoutfields
methods.description: Removes layout fields.

methods.name: uninstall_relationship
methods.description: Removes a relationship and associated metadata files.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Performs uninstallation of the module, including relationship removal, file cleanup, cache reset, and final rebuilding.

methods.name: rebuild_languages
methods.description: Rebuilds language files for specified languages and modules.

methods.name: rebuild_vardefs
methods.description: Rebuilds vardefs extensions.

methods.name: rebuild_dashletcontainers
methods.description: Rebuilds dashlet container files.

methods.name: rebuild_tabledictionary
methods.description: Rebuilds table dictionary extension.

methods.name: rebuild_relationships
methods.description: Rebuilds module relationships.

methods.name: remove_acl_actions
methods.description: Removes ACL actions for the module.

methods.name: repair_indices
methods.description: Wrapper for repairing database indices.

methods.name: rebuild_all
methods.description: Rebuilds all extension files, language packs, relationships, and cache.

methods.name: merge_files
methods.description: Consolidates code extensions for modules and application from various override directories.

methods.name: install_modules
methods.description: Generates initial bean list and module registration files.

methods.name: install_beans
methods.description: Instantiates beans, creates tables, and generates relationship metadata for modules.

methods.name: uninstall_beans
methods.description: Drops database tables for modules.

methods.name: uninstall_customizations
methods.description: Removes custom layouts and extensions created in Studio for the modules.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs debug messages and outputs to browser if not silent.

methods.name: copy_recursive_with_backup
methods.description: Recursively copies files with optional backup, supporting uninstall mode.

methods.name: dir_get_files
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all files in a directory.

methods.name: dir_file_count
methods.description: Counts total files in a directory and subdirectories.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts installation with error messages and redirects.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Retrieves errors stored in session during install steps.

methods.name: addFieldsToLayout
methods.description: Adds custom fields to module layouts for deployed modules.

methods.name: removeFieldsFromLayout
methods.description: Removes custom fields from module layouts for deployed modules.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables module components based on manifest.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables module components based on manifest.

methods.name: enable_vardef
methods.description: Enables vardef extensions for a module.

methods.name: enable_layoutdef
methods.description: Enables layoutdef extensions for a module.

methods.name: enable_relationships
methods.description: Enables and includes relationship metadata.

methods.name: disable_relationships
methods.description: Disables relationship metadata by moving files to disabled directories.

methods.name: enable_dashlets
methods.description: Enables dashlets in the system.

methods.name: disable_dashlets
methods.description: Disables dashlets in the system.

methods.name: enable_copy
methods.description: Copies back restored files into the system during enable.

methods.name: disable_copy
methods.description: Restores files to backup locations during disable.

methods.name: reset_opcodes
methods.description: Resets opcode cache if function exists.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic call extensions for enabling/disabling/installing extensions.
